title: Mario is named after Nintendo's landlord.
caption: Mario is named after Nintendo's landlord. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #mario #nintendo #donkeykong

instagram.caption:
Mario is named after Nintendo's landlord.

In Donkey Kong (1981) he was just "Jumpman". Around that time Mario Segale, who owned Nintendo of America's warehouse, came by asking for late rent.

The staff started calling the character Mario, and it stuck. His cap and mustache exist because hair and a mouth were too hard to draw in so few pixels.
